modern_research.desc: 桑叶中的1-脱氧野尻霉素（DNJ）具有显著的α-葡萄糖苷酶抑制活性，有助于控制餐后血糖。
modern_research.desc_en: Demonstrates significant bioactivity and modern pharmacological evidence supporting therapeutic efficacy in clinical and experimental studies.

modern_research.title: 降血脂与抗动脉粥样硬化
modern_research.desc: 桑叶提取物能降低血清总胆固醇、甘油三酯和低密度脂蛋白，抑制脂质过氧化。
modern_research.title_en: 降血脂与抗动脉粥样硬化
modern_research.desc_en: Demonstrates significant bioactivity and modern pharmacological evidence supporting therapeutic efficacy in clinical and experimental studies.

modern_research.title: 抗菌抗病毒
modern_research.desc: 桑叶水煎剂及黄酮类成分对金黄色葡萄球菌、大肠杆菌及某些流感病毒有不同程度的抑制作用。
modern_research.desc_en: Demonstrates significant bioactivity and modern pharmacological evidence supporting therapeutic efficacy in clinical and experimental studies.

modern_research.title: 抗炎与镇痛
modern_research.desc: 桑叶多糖和黄酮类化合物能通过抑制炎症因子的释放来发挥抗炎和镇痛作用。
modern_research.desc_en: Demonstrates significant bioactivity and modern pharmacological evidence supporting therapeutic efficacy in clinical and experimental studies.

modern_research.title: 抗氧化与抗衰老
modern_research.desc: 桑叶富含多酚类物质和维生素，能有效清除自由基，减轻氧化应激损伤。
modern_research.desc_en: Demonstrates significant bioactivity and modern pharmacological evidence supporting therapeutic efficacy in clinical and experimental studies.

modern_research.title: 调节免疫功能
modern_research.desc: 桑叶多糖能促进淋巴细胞增殖，增强巨噬细胞的吞噬活性，从而调节机体免疫力。
modern_research.desc_en: Demonstrates significant bioactivity and modern pharmacological evidence supporting therapeutic efficacy in clinical and experimental studies.
